name: Miu
source:
The story of the girl singing inside a birdcage, and the young man who was captivated by her song.

With only 7 days left till the man faces his ‘end’, will they reach happiness and salvation…?

[from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/25/game-review-digicla-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
